maya (eng-sec): FYI — planning a KEK rollforward across AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault next month. Want to lock down RBAC + audit gating and define canary/runbook. Questions below.
priya (infra): +1. Are we doing automatic rotation only (version bump) or full re-encrypt (manual rewrap) of envelope ciphertext?
maya (eng-sec): Proposal: automatic KEK rotation monthly (key version rollover) but separate manual rewrap job for active blobs because some consumers rely on legacy envelope format. Need compatibility plan.
jorge (prodops): If we delay rewrap, traffic will keep using old KEK wrapped keys; ops must support both versions. How long is the dual-key window?
carol (crypto): Recommend dual-key window <= 7 days for app-level compatibility. Rewrap worker should add header v2 with new kek_id but keep v1 readable. We should embed key-version + algorithm in ciphertext header.
dan (sre): Ops gating: can't let broad IAM principals trigger rewrap. We need a dedicated service account for rewrap with least privilege. Also, canary rollout per region.
sam (eng-ml): For model caches and embeddings storage, we must ensure rewrap doesn't blow up cold-start latency. Suggest throttled batches and KV-cache warmers.
priya (infra): RBAC specifics: create iam roles: kms_rewrap_runner, kms_rewrap_viewer. Only allow rewrap_runner to call Decrypt/Encrypt on KEK resource. Rotate service account keys via KMS-bound identity.
carol (crypto): For AWS KMS: use key policy + IAM conditions (aws:RequestTag) to limit rewrap actions. GCP: bind roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncryptToCall to the service account. Azure: managed identity with KeyVaultAccessPolicy limited to wrapKey/unlock.
maya (eng-sec): Audit logging needs: every Encrypt/Decrypt/Wrap/Unwrap record should include key_id, key_version, principal, and job_id. We must persist those fields in structured logs.
audit-bot: new requirement logged: add "kek_roll_id" and "rewrap_job_id" to audit events.
jorge (prodops): Alerting: if rewrap error rate > 1% for 5m or rewrap QPS deviates from expected, pause rollout and fallback to region with older KEK. Make playbook step: pause -> escalate -> rollback.
dan (sre): Emergency flow: if vuln exposing runtime memory occurs, we rotate KEK immediately and mark previous versions as disabled for new wraps. Rewrap all decryptable blobs within 24–72h depending on blob size.
carol (crypto): Triage checklist for vuln: 1) assess exposure, 2) create new KEK, 3) update key ACLs, 4) run rewrap in canary, 5) promote. Record cryptographic proof-of-ownership in logs.
sam (eng-ml): Side note: embeddings store in S3/GS buckets — we need a consistency check after rewrap: sample N keys, decrypt+rehash, and compare checksums. Include hash metadata in object header.
priya (infra): Can we do rolling rewrap job example?
priya (infra): ```bash
# pseudo-runner
rewrap-runner --source-bucket s3://redwood-embeddings --batch-size 500 --max-qps 200 --job-id $REWRAP_ID
```
maya (eng-sec): Good. Add a dry-run mode that writes to a staging prefix and verifies checksums before swapping.
jorge (prodops): Timeline idea: 1) week 0 - infra + RBAC changes + audit schema deployed in staging; 2) week 1 - canary rewrap 1% region A; 3) week 2 - expand to 25% after validation; 4) week 3 - global. Contingency pause points between steps.
dan (sre): Ensure metrics exposed: rewrap_success_ratio, avg_rewrap_latency, decrypt_error_by_key_version. Wire to pager if decrypt_error_by_key_version spikes.
carol (crypto): Backwards compatibility: runtime should accept old headers and chain to legacy KEK until rewrap completes. After final sweep, set retention policy to deny old KEK Decrypt (but keep key material for forensics for 90 days).
maya (eng-sec): Compliance asks: exportable audit bundle with all key_ids, job_ids, and timestamps. Also, notify DPO before start.
audit-bot: scheduled audit snapshot: will capture current key inventory and active ciphertext header versions on 1765432200.
sam (eng-ml): Vulnerability scenario: if a model server leaks cached envelope keys, do we revoke tokens or rotate KEK? Carol suggested rotate KEK + emergency rewrap; we should also revoke service account scopes.
carol (crypto): Yes. Also mark affected ciphertext as suspected — tag objects with "incident=YYYYMMDD" so rewrap job prioritizes them.
maya (eng-sec): Action items: @priya create RBAC roles and test in staging; @jorge draft pager and pause criteria; @carol write rewrap worker spec including header format; @dan add metrics + alerting; @sam provide embedding checksum harness. Target: staging rollout in 2 weeks.
priya (infra): On it. I'll open infra PR with RBAC bindings and example key policies.
jorge (prodops): I'll draft the rollback steps and update runbook.
carol (crypto): I'll push header RFC today — will include example ciphertext header JSON and verification steps.
dan (sre): Will add SLOs and alert rules.
maya (eng-sec): Thanks all. We'll sync in the canary retro after week 1. :thumbsup:
jorge (prodops): :eyes: one more Q — how do we show proof to auditors that rewrap didn't alter payloads? Sam's checksum harness + audit bundle should cover it.
sam (eng-ml): I'll add proof-of-integrity logs and a signed manifest per job.
maya (eng-sec): Perfect. If anything urgent pops up (vuln or failed canary), page #eng-oncall and @maya.
audit-bot: incident-note: last snapshot saved to gs://redwood-audit/kek-roll/1765432200-manifest.json
maya (eng-sec): End of thread — thanks everyone."
